blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Ratio represents a comparative relation between two quantities of similar units.
Fractional ratios must be cleared by multiplying each term by the LCM of their denominators.
Proportion establishes the equality between two given ratios (a:b = c:d).
Compound ratio is derived by multiplying the antecedents together and the consequents together.
Distribution problems split a whole quantity into proportional shares based on given ratios.
A ratio is a comparison of two quantities of the same kind.

Ratio of a and b = a : b

Example:

Ratio of 10 and 20 = 10 : 20 = 1 : 2
When two ratios are equal, they form a proportion.

a : b = c : d

This can also be written as:

a × d = b × c

In SSC examination, questions from this topic are:

• Direct

• Formula-based

• Mostly numerical

blocks.content:
• Ratio has no unit.

• Both terms must be of the same unit.

• Ratio can be simplified like fractions.

• Ratio remains same if both terms are multiplied or divided by the same number.

Example 1:

Find the ratio of 45 minutes to 1.5 hours.

Solution:

1.5 hours = 90 minutes

45 : 90 = 1 : 2

Answer: 1 : 2

If a : b = c : d, then:

a × d = b × c
Compound ratio is the ratio obtained by multiplying corresponding terms of two or more ratios.

Example 5:

Divide ₹600 between A and B in the ratio 2 : 3.

Solution:

Total parts = 2 + 3 = 5

A’s share = (2/5) × 600 = 240

B’s share = (3/5) × 600 = 360

Answer: A = ₹240, B = ₹360

• Convert all quantities to the same unit.

• Simplify ratios to lowest form.

• Use proportion formula carefully.

• Ratio questions are often combined with percentage.

items: Always simplify ratios into whole numbers by taking the LCM when fractions are present.
Compound ratio questions frequently appear in multi-variable equivalence problems.
Ensure quantities are expressed in identical units before calculating ratios.

blocks.content:
Example 6:

The ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3 : 2. If there are 30 boys, find the number of girls.

Solution:

3 : 2 = 30 : x

x = 20

Answer: 20



Example 7:

If a : b = 5 : 7 and b : c = 14 : 15, find a : c.

Solution:

a : b = 10 : 14

b : c = 14 : 15

a : c = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3

Answer: 2 : 3
